gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-glegoo: Pramukh Rounded packs its glyphs tight together. Glegoo, a classic serif, follows with big counters and wide mouths on its curves, and a larger size for the headline would suit that snug heading.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-hanuman: Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase, brings a traditional, refined voice to the text. And Pramukh Rounded handles the heading with friendly, tightly bunched glyphs, while Hanuman's wide-set terminals on s carry the reading.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-kadwa: Friendly and tightly bunched, Pramukh Rounded makes a compact heading with open bowls. And Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a generous x-height, would carry a long passage with an editorial, easygoing flow.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-noticia-text: Tightly bunched glyphs give Pramukh Rounded its look. Noticia Text, a classic serif, has big visible entrances into its curves and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height, so a modest heading size would keep the two in step.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-piazzolla: Pramukh Rounded sits tight and friendly. Piazzolla, a classic serif, has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e pried open like a clasp, which gives the text an authoritative, refined footing under that rounded heading.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-pridi: Pridi, a text serif, stands its small letters proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space where curves meet the stem. Pridi keeps a long read classic and refined beneath Pramukh Rounded's tight, friendly heading.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-scope-one: Traditional and refined, Scope One spills its counters out into the surrounding space beside a big x-height. Pramukh Rounded, bunched tight and friendly above it, makes the serif text feel unhurried.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px opens large counters in its a, e and s. Slabo 13px, a text serif, would feel oversized if blown up large, while Pramukh Rounded would turn cramped if made small.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, with a very open c and an x-height standing tall like a squared-off woodblock letter. Against Pramukh Rounded's tight, friendly glyphs, that serif is the pair's real draw.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-paquito: Quilon's gentle ebb and flow of stroke thickness gives the heading its commanding editorial voice. And Paquito, a serif with a minimal gap between x-height and caps, stays confident and approachable, comfortable in small doses.
